subject: Английский язык
authors: Верещагина И. Н., Афанасьева О. В.

problems.condition: Round-up Lessons 1–8, упр. 1, с. 4. Дополни предложения формой глагола be: am, is, are.
steps: 1. are; 2. are; 3. is; 4. is; 5. are; 6. am; 7. are.
problems.answer: are, are, is, is, are, am, are

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 2, с. 4. По картинкам на с. 5 напиши, какие питомцы у детей и какого они цвета.
steps: Kate's cat is grey. Donald's dog is black and white. The friends' parrot is green. The brothers' cat is red. The Browns' horses are brown. The teacher's dogs are white.
problems.answer: Kate's cat — grey; Donald's dog — black and white; the friends' parrot — green; the brothers' cat — red; the Browns' horses — brown; the teacher's dogs — white

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 3, с. 5. Дополни предложения have got / haven't got.
steps: 1. has got; 2. Have you got; 3. have got; 4. haven't got; 5. hasn't got; 6. have got; 7. has got.
problems.answer: has got, have you got, have got, haven't got, hasn't got, have got, has got

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 4, с. 6. Образуй множественное число существительных.
steps: shoes, parties, birthdays, tortoises, eyes, shops, families, houses, mice, wolves, boxes, children, wives, hares, feet, leaves, potatoes, glasses, teeth, exercises, puppies, sheep.
problems.answer: shoes, parties, birthdays, tortoises, eyes, shops, families, houses, mice, wolves, boxes, children, wives, hares, feet, leaves, potatoes, glasses, teeth, exercises, puppies, sheep

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 5, с. 6. Дополни предложения конструкцией there is / there are.
steps: 1. There are; 2. Are there; 3. Are there; 4. There is; 5. There aren't; 6. There isn't.
problems.answer: there are, are there, are there, there is, there aren't, there isn't

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 6, с. 7. Дополни предложения some или any.
steps: 1. some; 2. any; 3. any; 4. any; 5. some; 6. any.
problems.answer: some, any, any, any, some, any

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 7, с. 7. Дополни предложения much / many и раздели на две группы.
steps: much — 1, 3, 4, 7 (неисчисляемые); many — 2, 5, 6 (исчисляемые).

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 8, с. 8. По таблице составь предложения о Роберте.
steps: Robert wears jackets but he doesn't wear coats. Robert wears sweaters but he doesn't wear gloves. Robert buys ice cream but he doesn't buy carrots. Robert buys milk but he doesn't buy salt. Robert likes fish but he doesn't like cold porridge. Robert likes juice but he doesn't like coffee.
problems.answer: Robert wears / buys / likes … but he doesn't …

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 9, с. 8. Перепиши предложения, раскрыв скобки (наречия частоты).
steps: When does Helen usually get up? Does he often come home late? He doesn't often go to the cinema. We don't usually wear shorts in autumn. She sometimes has fish for lunch.
problems.answer: usually, often, often, usually, sometimes — перед глаголом

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 10, с. 9. Раскрой скобки: Present Simple или Present Continuous.
steps: 1. is going; 2. goes; 3. are drinking; 4. plays football; 5. looks after; 6. is swimming.
problems.answer: is going, goes, are drinking, plays, looks after, is swimming

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 11, с. 9. Перепиши предложения в прошедшем времени.
steps: He had coffee for breakfast yesterday. My cousin was late for school three days ago. They didn't come to school at 11 last year. The lessons began at 8.30 last Friday. My mother brought interesting books last week. He wore warm clothes last winter.
problems.answer: had, was, didn't come, began, brought, wore

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 12, с. 10. Сравни животных по образцу.
steps: cleverer, slower, nicer, better, more beautiful, funnier, worse.
problems.answer: cleverer, slower, nicer, better, more beautiful, funnier, worse

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 13, с. 10. Прочитай историю и скажи, что умеет и не умеет мистер Браун.
steps: Mr Brown can grow vegetables. He can talk with animals. He can understand birds and animals. He can tell people stories about the wonders of the forest. He can't play games. He can't work on a computer.
problems.answer: can — grow vegetables, talk with animals, tell stories; can't — play games, work on a computer

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 14, с. 11. Выбери правильную форму глагола.
steps: 1. snows; 2. snows; 3. is raining; 4. rained; 5. rain; 6. isn't snowing.
problems.answer: snows, snows, is raining, rained, rain, isn't snowing

problems.condition: Round-up, упр. 15, с. 11. Переведи предложения на английский.
steps: It rained yesterday. It often snows in November. It is raining, but it isn't cold outside. Is it snowing now? Stay at home — it's raining. We like watching TV when it rains. It doesn't often rain here. Did it snow yesterday?
problems.answer: it rained, it snows, it is raining, is it snowing, did it snow

problems.condition: School life, Lessons 9–16, упр. 1, с. 13. Скажи, когда у девочки физкультура, рисование, музыка и труд.
steps: She has got P.E. on Tuesday and Friday. She has got Art on Tuesday and Thursday. She has got Music on Wednesday and Friday. She has got Handicraft on Friday.
problems.answer: P.E. — Tuesday, Friday; Art — Tuesday, Thursday; Music — Wednesday, Friday; Handicraft — Friday

problems.condition: School life, упр. 2, с. 13. Расскажи о расписании мальчика зимой и летом.
steps: In winter he plays football at 5 on Tuesday, volleyball at 3 on Wednesday, basketball at 11 on Thursday, swims at 6 on Friday, skis at 9 on Saturday and skates at 10 on Sunday.
In summer he plays tennis at 2 on Tuesday, volleyball at 12 on Wednesday, baseball at 1 on Thursday, runs at 7 on Friday, swims at 12 on Saturday and plays basketball at 10 on Sunday.
problems.answer: In winter / summer he … at … o'clock on …

problems.condition: School life, упр. 3, с. 15. a) Заполни пропуски предлогами; b) исправь предложения по тексту.
steps: a) on, after, in, at, in, in, at, at, at.

b) She usually had a walk at 1 o'clock in the afternoon. That day she had a walk after classes. She laughed at the boy because he looked funny. The boy ran because he wanted to stop two boys fighting. She usually went for a walk at noon in summer.
problems.answer: a) on, after, in, at, in, in, at, at, at; b) исправленные предложения по тексту

problems.condition: School life, упр. 4, с. 15. Скажи, во сколько идут передачи.
steps: «The Weather» is on at half past eight. «Sports» is on at half past ten. The film is on at half past nine. The second film is on at half past eleven. The cartoon is on at half past twelve.
problems.answer: half past eight, half past ten, half past nine, half past eleven, half past twelve

problems.condition: School life, упр. 5, с. 16. Заполни пропуски в разделительных вопросах.
steps: 1. can we? 2. shan't we? 3. isn't he? 4. didn't they? 5. doesn't it? 6. isn't it?
problems.answer: can we, shan't we, isn't he, didn't they, doesn't it, isn't it

problems.condition: School life, упр. 6, с. 16. Ответь на вопросы (Past Simple).
steps: I worked in the garden yesterday. I counted books yesterday. I met my friends yesterday. I drank milk yesterday. I wrote a letter yesterday.
problems.answer: worked, counted, met, drank, wrote

problems.condition: School life, упр. 7, с. 16. Заполни пропуски в пословицах и вспомни русские аналоги.
steps: It is never too late to learn. — Учиться никогда не поздно. Better late than never. — Лучше поздно, чем никогда. A good beginning makes a good ending. — Хорошее начало — полдела откачало.
problems.answer: late, learn; never; makes, ending

problems.condition: School life, упр. 8, с. 17. Раздели слова на группы: существительные, глаголы, прилагательные.
steps: Nouns: book, carpet, exercise, floor, museum, picture, rubber, song, subject, uniform, window. Verbs: count, join, laugh, learn, leave, meet, spend, study. Adjectives: comfortable, difficult, important, poor.
problems.answer: nouns — book, carpet, museum, subject…; verbs — count, join, laugh, learn…; adjectives — comfortable, difficult, important, poor

problems.condition: School life, упр. 9, с. 17. Предложи свою помощь (Shall I…?).
steps: Shall I make the bed? Shall I wash the floor? Shall I wash the dishes? Shall I put the books in the bookcase? Shall I close the bookcase?
problems.answer: Shall I make / wash / put / close …?

problems.condition: School life, упр. 10, с. 18. Раздели глаголы на правильные и неправильные.
steps: Regular: count, join, laugh, study, work. Irregular: be, get, leave, meet, sing.
problems.answer: regular — count, join, laugh, study, work; irregular — be, get, leave, meet, sing

problems.condition: School life, упр. 11, с. 18. Заполни пропуски предлогами.
steps: 1. on; 2. by; 3. at; 4. to, on; 5. for; 6. in; 7. for; 8. —; 9. at; 10. on, with, at.
problems.answer: on, by, at, to / on, for, in, for, —, at, on / with / at

problems.condition: School life, упр. 12, с. 19. Расскажи, как часто девочка делает разные вещи.
steps: She goes to school five times a week. She goes to the cinema twice a week. She goes to the swimming pool twice a week. She goes to the theatre once a week. She goes to the museum once a week. She goes to the zoo once a week.
problems.answer: five times a week, twice a week, once a week

problems.condition: School life, упр. 13, с. 19. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: He came on Thursday. His name was Peter Rivers. Miss Fair asked him to sit next to Tom. The lesson was Maths. He counted well. The children had lunch after Maths, at half past twelve. Tom took out fish, an old apple and old cheese. They laughed at Tom because his bag was full of rubbish. Peter gave him an egg and some bread.
problems.answer: Thursday; Peter Rivers; next to Tom; Maths; lunch at 12.30; rubbish in the bag; an egg and bread

problems.condition: School life, упр. 14, с. 21. Прочитай слова и фразы.
steps: age, blackboard, bookcase, carpet, class, comfortable, count, desk, difficult, floor, important, join, laugh, learn, leave, museum, rubber, ruler, song, spend, subject, timetable, uniform, window.
problems.answer: Читаем слова раздела «Школа».

problems.condition: School life, упр. 15, с. 22. Прочитай слова и вспомни их перевод.
steps: answer — ответ; atmosphere — атмосфера; computer — компьютер; diary — дневник; geography — география; history — история; hour — час; kilometre — километр; metre — метр; programme — программа.
problems.answer: answer, atmosphere, computer, diary, geography, history, hour, kilometre

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 1, с. 23. Составь предложения о том, что это за предметы.
steps: A kitchen is a place where we cook. A bathroom is a room where we wash. A flower is a plant. A key is a thing for opening doors. A bedroom is a room where we sleep. A hall is a place where we take off our coats. A house is a building where we live.
problems.answer: A kitchen is a place where…; a key is a thing for…; a house is a building where…

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 2, с. 23. a) Вставь предлоги; b) выбери картинку, подходящую под описание.
steps: a) in, in, of, behind, over, of, in, of.
b) Picture 1 matches the description.
problems.answer: a) in, in, of, behind, over, of, in, of; b) picture 1

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 3, с. 25. Нарисуй план своей квартиры и подпиши комнаты.
steps: Рисуем план и подписываем: hall — коридор, bathroom — ванная, kitchen — кухня, living room — гостиная, bedroom — спальня.
problems.answer: hall, bathroom, kitchen, living room, bedroom

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 4, с. 25. Выбери слова, которые описывают комнату.
steps: comfortable, warm, quiet, small, large, light, clean.
problems.answer: comfortable, warm, quiet, small, large

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 5, с. 25. Прочитай предложения: True или False.
steps: 1. False. 2. False. 3. False. 4. False. 5. True. 6. True.
problems.answer: F, F, F, F, T, T

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 6, с. 26. Составь вопросы о квартире (Is there…? Are there…?).
steps: Is there a table / an armchair / a sofa / a TV / a carpet in your living room? Are there curtains in your living room? Is there a mirror / a lamp / a wardrobe / a bed in your bedroom? Is there a desk / a computer / a bookcase in your study? Is there a cooker / a fridge / a cupboard in your kitchen?
problems.answer: Is there a … in your living room / bedroom / study / kitchen? Are there curtains…?

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 7, с. 26. a) Где обедали мальчики? b) True / False / Don't know.
steps: a) The boys had lunch in the kitchen.
b) 1. False. 2. False. 3. Don't know. 4. True. 5. Don't know. 6. True.
problems.answer: a) in the kitchen; b) F, F, don't know, T, don't know, T

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 8, с. 28. Прочитай и выучи слова и фразы.
steps: Существительные: house, flat, kitchen, bathroom, toilet, living room, bedroom, dining room, study, hall, key, car, furniture, sofa, armchair, curtain, mirror, cupboard, fridge, cooker, sink, wardrobe, lamp. Глаголы: lock, shout, happen, believe, describe, move, relax. Прилагательные: lovely, wonderful, quiet, expensive.
problems.answer: Слова раздела «Дом»: комнаты, мебель, глаголы, прилагательные.

problems.condition: Lessons 17–23, упр. 9, с. 28. Прочитай и пойми значение слов.
steps: car — автомобиль, hotel — отель, police — полиция, officer — офицер, address — адрес, stairs — лестница, person — человек, burglar — грабитель, chimney — печная труба; close — закрывать.
problems.answer: car, hotel, police, officer, address, stairs, person, burglar, chimney, close

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 1, с. 29. Впиши неопределённый артикль a / an.
steps: a main road, an old church, an American city, a square, a theatre, a cinema, a fireplace, a church, an armchair, an Englishman, a primary school, an African town, a modern city, an English school.
problems.answer: an — перед гласным звуком (old, American, armchair, Englishman, African, English); a — перед согласным

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 2, с. 29. Запиши три формы глаголов и распредели по чтению окончания -ed.
steps: /t/: laugh — laughed, work — worked, lock — locked. /d/: study — studied, join — joined, describe — described, happen — happened, believe — believed. /ɪd/: count — counted, shout — shouted, start — started.
problems.answer: /t/ laughed, worked, locked; /d/ studied, joined, described, happened, believed; /ɪd/ counted, shouted, started

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 3, с. 30. По картинкам напиши, где ты уже был, а где ещё нет.
steps: I have already been to the church. I have never been to the USA. I haven't been to London yet. I have already been to the cinema. I have never been to St Petersburg. I haven't been to the museum yet. I have already been to the park.
problems.answer: have already been / have never been / haven't been … yet

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 4, с. 31. Впиши недостающие формы глаголов.
steps: be — was/were — been; see — saw — seen; read — read — read; buy — bought — bought; bring — brought — brought; meet — met — met; build — built — built; wake — woke — woken; burn — burnt — burnt; become — became — become.
problems.answer: been, seen, read, bought, brought, met, built, woken, burnt, become

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 5, с. 31. Впиши недостающие предлоги (the monument to…).
steps: This is the monument to Yuri Dolgoruky / to Leo Tolstoy / to Nikolai Gogol / to Admiral Nelson / to Peter the Great / to Alexander Pushkin / to Yuri Gagarin.
problems.answer: to — во всех предложениях

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 6, с. 32. Дополни вопросы.
steps: 1. …or in the living room? 2. …or in the kitchen? 3. …or to your aunt? 4. …or a new cooker? 5. …or doesn't he believe them? 6. …or to the Tower of London? 7. …or on a trip to Scotland? 8. …or to the left?
problems.answer: in the living room; in the kitchen; to your aunt; a new cooker; doesn't he believe; to the Tower; to Scotland; to the left

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 7, с. 32. Напиши, сколько времени тебе нужно, чтобы добраться до места.
steps: It takes me an hour to get to the theatre. It takes me half an hour to get to the cinema. It takes me 10 minutes to get to the museum. It takes me 15 minutes to get to school. It takes me 45 minutes to get to the bridge. It takes me 5 minutes to get to my friend's house. It takes me half an hour to get to the main square. It takes me two hours to get to my granny's house.
problems.answer: It takes me … to get to …

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 8, с. 32. Впиши предлоги, где нужно.
steps: 1. in front of; 2. in (at the back of); 3. by; 4. in, in, of; 5. to, in; 6. to; 7. of; 8. to; 9. to; 10. to, in, of.
problems.answer: in front of; at the back; by car; in the corner, in the middle of; talk to, in a hurry; next to; sure of; happen to; been to; monument to, in the square of

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 9, с. 33. Напиши, что собираются делать эти люди.
steps: Nelly is going to go to school. Nick is going to open the door. The pupils are going to sing. The boy is going to draw. They are going to buy a wardrobe.
problems.answer: is / are going to go, open, sing, draw, buy

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 10, с. 34. Задай другу вопросы о покупке машины (to be going to).
steps: Are you going to buy a car? When are you going to buy it? What colour is it going to be? Are you going to buy an expensive car? Are you going to buy a big or a small car?
problems.answer: Are you going to …? When / What colour …?

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 11, с. 34. Дополни предложения словами yet, already, ever, never, just.
steps: We have already been to the Tower of London. She hasn't woken up yet. Peter Brown has never seen Westminster Abbey. Has he become an architect yet? Have they ever been to Buckingham Palace? They haven't built a monument in the square yet.
problems.answer: already, yet, never, yet, ever, yet

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 12, с. 34. Прочитай, переведи и запомни слова и фразы.
steps: town, city, square, main, road, church, cinema, theatre, traffic lights, capital, tower, bell, monument, bridge, century, wide, trip, king, queen; turn to the left, walk two blocks, be afraid of, wake up.
problems.answer: Слова раздела «Город. Лондон».

problems.condition: Lessons 24–30, упр. 13, с. 35. Прочитай и переведи слова.
steps: supermarket — супермаркет; opera — опера; hospital — больница; post office — почта; office — офис; fact — факт; million — миллион; thousand — тысяча; business — бизнес; centre — центр.
problems.answer: supermarket, opera, hospital, post office, office, fact, million, thousand, business

chapters.title: Basic course. Travelling and transport. Lessons 31-36

problems.condition: Travelling, Lessons 31–36, упр. 1, с. 36. Образуй три формы глаголов и раздели на правильные и неправильные.
steps: Regular: laugh — laughed — laughed; study — studied; happen — happened; describe — described; lock — locked; count — counted; work — worked; join — joined.

Irregular: be — was/were — been; build — built — built; become — became — become; burn — burnt — burnt; read — read — read; lead — led — led; come — came — come; keep — kept — kept; learn — learnt — learnt; take — took — taken; say — said — said; wake — woke — woken; go — went — gone; get — got — got; know — knew — known; hear — heard — heard; do — did — done.
problems.answer: regular — -ed; irregular — be, build, become, burn, read, lead, come, keep, learn, take, say, wake, go, get, know, hear, do

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 2, с. 37. Прочитай диалог и напиши, как люди ехали в Мурманск, Архангельск, на Белое море и на чём ездили по городам.
steps: They travelled to Murmansk by plane. They travelled to Arkhangelsk by train. They travelled to the White Sea by car. In Murmansk and Arkhangelsk they went by bus.
problems.answer: Murmansk — by plane; Arkhangelsk — by train; the White Sea — by car; in the cities — by bus

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 3, с. 37. Дополни предложения глаголами в подходящем времени.
steps: 1. began; 2. hasn't drunk; 3. have just chosen; 4. drew; 5. have already had; 6. have eaten; 7. spent; 8. have never swum.
problems.answer: began, hasn't drunk, have just chosen, drew, have already had, have eaten, spent, have never swum

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 4, с. 38. Заполни пропуски в таблице форм глаголов.
steps: built, built; see, saw; forgot, forgotten; shake, shaken; read, read; be, was/were; flew, flown; bring, brought; buy, bought; found, found; meet, met; woke, woken; steal, stole; burnt, burnt; lead, led; became, become.
problems.answer: built, saw, forgot/forgotten, shaken, read, was/were, flew/flown, brought, bought, found, met, woke/woken, stole, burnt, led, became/become

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 5, с. 39. Опиши картинки (who / which).
steps: This is a man who likes to travel by plane. This is a man who bought a ticket. These are gloves which were bought in Scotland. This is a woman who missed a train. This is a picture which was taken in Trafalgar Square. This is a girl who met me at the railway station. This is a train which stands at the station.
problems.answer: who — о людях; which — о предметах

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 6, с. 40. a) Напиши противоположные словосочетания; b) подбери антонимы.
steps: a) to get out of the car; to take the train; to miss a train; to go downstairs; to get off a horse; to get into a taxi; to catch a plane.
b) pretty, easy, dirty, cheap, weak, sell, behind.
problems.answer: a) get out of, take, miss, downstairs, get off, get into, catch; b) pretty, easy, dirty, cheap, weak, sell, behind

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 7, с. 41. Скажи, на чём можно добраться из одного места в другое.
steps: by train, by plane, by tube, by taxi.
problems.answer: by train, by plane, by tube, by taxi

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 8, с. 41. Заполни пропуски предлогами.
steps: 1. by; 2. by, in; 3. at; 4. at; 5. to; 6. on; 7. of; 8. on.
problems.answer: by; by, in; at; at; to; on; of; on

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 9, с. 41. Ответь на вопрос, используя глагол get.
steps: He is getting out of the car. He is getting off the bus.
problems.answer: getting out of the car; getting off the bus

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 10, с. 41. Переделай предложения по образцу (have to).
steps: You have to walk along the path. You have to speak quietly in the library. You have to be in time for the performance. You have to visit the museum without a camera. You have to listen to the teacher in class. You have to go to bed at 10 o'clock.
problems.answer: You have to …

problems.condition: Travelling, упр. 11, с. 42. Запиши как можно больше неправильных глаголов в трёх формах.
steps: be — was/were — been; become — became — become; build — built — built; buy — bought — bought; meet — met — met; read — read — read; see — saw — seen; burn — burnt — burnt; come — came — come; do — did — done; get — got — got; go — went — gone; hear — heard — heard; keep — kept — kept; know — knew — known; learn — learnt — learnt; say — said — said; take — took — taken; wake — woke — woken; begin — began — begun; choose — chose — chosen; draw — drew — drawn; drink — drank — drunk; eat — ate — eaten; have — had — had.

steps: a) The flag is red, white and blue — «the Stars and Stripes»; 50 stars for 50 states, 13 red and white stripes for the first 13 colonies; you can see it at schools, in streets, squares, shops and offices.
b) The Statue of Liberty: 1884, a gift from France, a symbol of friendship between France and the USA, in New York.
c) The eagle: since 1782; the olive branch — peace, the arrows — strength; on the back of the dollar bill.
d) Uncle Sam: a cartoon symbol of the American government, in magazines, posters and newspapers, since the 19th century; U.S. = United States = Uncle Sam.
